title.narrative: Support to the Technical Secretariat of the Coherence Fund for Stabilisation, Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative: Created in 2016, the DRC Stabilization Coherence Fund is the principal programmatic mechanism for project implementation under the International Security and Stabilization Support Strategy (ISSSS). Finances are invested in six projects in six priority zones of the Democratic Republic of Congo, in support of Fund management, monitoring and evaluation practices, and political engagement. UNOPS supports the work of the Technical Secretariat of the Coherence Fund for Stabilisation.
